about: Experience Tekken 6 originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

This is a whole lot of fighting action packed into one game! Graphics which spotlight fighting action, a cast of 40 unique characters, and a battle system that has been refined over the series’ long history.
The game also features Story Battle, which allows players to experience the story of each character, and Gold Rush, a mode unique to the PSP™ version!
In addition, each character’s appearance can be customized to your liking!
Hand-to-hand battle in a test of power - the Tekken saga continues!

*This title has been converted from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
*Some game play may differ from the PSP™ version, but there is no impact on game progression.
*Multiplayer and exchanging ghost data with other users are not supported.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: Experience Tekken 6 originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
